title: Value Operator Properties
body_html:
Value Operator Properties

For finite real matrix games, the value operator $A \mapsto \operatorname{val}(A)$ is continuous, monotone increasing, and non-expansive for the sup norm: $$ |\operatorname{val}(A)-\operatorname{val}(B)| \le \|A-B\|_\infty. $$

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 2, Section 2.3, after Theorem 2.3.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Continuity, monotonicity, and non-expansiveness of val.
